title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation | TechCrunch
summary: Google rolled out a new feature on Thursday that allowed users to deploy Nano Banana 2, its AI image generator, to create fabricated images inside its satellite imagery mapping app Google Earth.
